description: Standing Approvals for Oil Spill Treatment Products (England and Wales) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Marine Management Organisation. The use of oil spill treatment products (including dispersants) in waters of 20 metres depth or less, or within 1nm of any such area requires approval from the licensing authority. For England and Wales, the MMO are the relevant licensing authority. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Marine Management Organisation. The portal shows 2016-04-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
